newsitem.title: USA: ADE Corp acquires Digital Measurement.
newsitem.headline: ADE Corp acquires Digital Measurement.

text.p: ADE Corp Tuesday said it has acquired Digital Measurement Systems Inc, a Burlington, Mass.-based firm.
All outstanding shares of DMS stock were exchanged for shares of ADE Corp common stock. Further terms of the deal were not disclosed.
DMS has been merged into ADE Technologies Inc, a subsidiary of ADE Corp, ADE said.
DMS supplies the disk media industry with test equipment used to measure the magnetic properties of thin film media.
ADE Corp is a supplier of metrology and inspection systems for the silicon wafer and computer disk manufacturing industries.
